title: cleisostoma montanum
intro: Cleisostoma montanum, commonly known as the Himalayan cleisostoma, is a species of flowering plant in the orchid family. It is used in traditional medicine, primarily due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may aid in reducing fever and alleviating pain. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Cleisostoma montanum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a subject of interest for further research.
